description: The K2 spaced-repetition engine, described. K2 stores no review dates: each item holds a probability p that halves on a correct answer and doubles on a wrong one, and items are drawn by Monte Carlo rejection sampling, so the pool self-organizes around current weaknesses and expands when it cools. Returns the update rule (including the deliberate hinted-answer exception), the selection and pool-expansion mechanics, the live tuning constants, and notes for porting it. Read this before simulate_k2_session.
name: explain_k2_algorithm
